'''The Liberation''' was an uprising that took place on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] in [[44 ABY]]. [[25,100 BBY|Millennia]] earlier, a [[Treaty of Vontor|treaty]] was made between the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]] and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]&mdash;the Klatooinians submitted themselves to eternal [[Slavery/Legends|servitude]] to the Hutts, so long as the Hutts protected the [[Fountain of Ancients]], a sacred [[wintrium]] fountain on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], from harm. The treaty remained intact for thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]], although by the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], many of the indentured Klatooinians began to feel unrest.

In 44 ABY, a group of allied [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] stopped on Klatooine during their [[Mission to the Maw|joint mission]] to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. They soon departed, but two [[ChaseMaster|Sith frigates]] remained behind and [[Violation|raided]] the Fountain of the Ancients. The Klatooinians called for help, and Hutts arrived and apprehended the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], but not before they had damaged the Fountain, allegedly taking wintrium samples. The Sith were brought to trial and condemned to [[Death/Legends|death]] for their actions, although it was also decided that the Hutts had responded to the threat to the best of their ability, thus upholding the treaty despite the damage the Fountain had suffered. The ruling came too late, however, as an uprising had begun across the planet, with the Klatooinians issuing a full revolt against their Hutt masters.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I fear that Klatooine is at a crucial juncture. We are beholding the end of something&mdash;and the birth of something new. And I fear it will be birthed in blood.|Darima Kedari|<ref name="Allies" />}}
Around [[25,100 BBY|25,000]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]] signed the [[Treaty of Vontor]] with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], dedicating themselves to eternal [[Slavery/Legends|servitude]] to the Hutts in exchange for the Hutts' protection of the [[Fountain of Ancients|Fountain of the Ancients]], a sacred [[wintrium]] Fountain located on the Klatooinian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]. They lived in service to the Hutts for thousands of years, although, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], many Klatooinians began to feel unrest. In [[44 ABY]], a group of [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] came to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] in preparation for their [[Mission to the Maw|joint mission]] to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. When they departed the [[Star system/Legends|system]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] decided to leave two of his [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] behind to meet with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who was bringing an [[Rockhound|asteroid tug]] for help in navigating the Maw. However, these [[Starship/Legends|ships']] actual intent was to steal wintrium samples from the Fountain.<ref name="Allies" />

[[File:JustLando-AlliesBackCover.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Lando Calrissian, mediator]]
The Sith in the [[ChaseMaster]] frigate ''[[Starstalker]]'' [[Violation|raided]] the Fountain. The Hutts were notified immediately, and several Klatooinian guards fought the Sith, although the Sith managed to take samples of wintrium from the Fountain before they were stopped. Calrissian and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] then arrived in-system, and were asked by Klatooinian [[Chancellor (Klatooinian)|Chancellor]] [[Darima Kedari]] to mediate the situation. The Sith [[Leeha Faal]] lied that the attack had been solely the idea of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vyn Holpur]] of the ''Starstalker'', and although Calrissian and Solo didn't believe her, they had no proof otherwise. Holpur and his crew were thus convicted and sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]], and Calrissian and Solo also decreed that&mdash;although they had failed to protect the Fountain&mdash;the Hutts had not actually violated the terms of their treaty with the Klatooinians. Due to remaining damages accrued to the Hutts during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], their resources were insufficient to fully protect the Fountain. Still, the Hutts had done everything within their ability to do so, so Calrissian and Solo were forced to uphold the treaty, thus condemning the Klatooinians to further servitude.<ref name="Allies" />

==Uprising==
{{Quote|There are riots occurring all over Klatooine. Hutts, even decent shop owners who have lived here for years, are being attacked.|Darima Kedari|<ref name="Allies" />}}
The decision on the matter came too late&mdash;Klatooinians across the planet had already begun to riot and revolt, and soon a full uprising was in place. The uprising quickly became violent, resulting in [[Lightfight|firefights]] and skirmishes in the [[City/Legends|cities]] of Klatooine. The revolt quickly gained [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] attention and that of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]], who was concerned by the chaos erupting across the galaxy as a result of many anti-slavery uprisings. [[Journalist/Legends|Reporter]] [[Madhi Vaandt]] for ''[[The Perre Needmo Newshour]]'' was scheduled to go to Klatooine to cover the uprising there as part of her running series on the practices of slavery throughout the galaxy, but she was tipped off by a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] nicknamed [[Blink]] to go to [[Blaudu Sextus]] instead,<ref name="Allies" /> where another [[Blaudu Sextus revolt|revolt]] had begun.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The uprising on Klatooine was first depicted in [[Christie Golden]]'s ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', the fifth installment in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.
